# Vib Apps Engine — AI & Developer Specification

> Canonical Schema: https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json
> Full Guide: https://apps.vib.tools/vib-apps-engine/vibtools-app-config.md
> Storefront: https://apps.vib.tools
> Edge Installer & Download Router: https://get.vib.tools

## Purpose
Any GitHub repository (public or private) can publish an application to `apps.vib.tools` and `get.vib.tools` simply by adding `.vibtools/apps/app.config.json` inside the repository and adding its GitHub repository URL to `registry.json` in `vib-apps-hub`.

## Required Repository Layout
```text
<app-repository-root>/
└── .vibtools/
    └── apps/
        ├── app.config.json    # Required — conforms strictly to vibtools-app.schema.json (schemaVersion: 1)
        ├── installer.ps1      # Default PowerShell installer script (or provide an HTTPS URL in installer)
        ├── features.md        # Markdown rendered in the "Features & Overview" tab
        └── changelog.md       # Markdown rendered in the "Release Changelog" tab
```

## Frozen Schema Contract (schemaVersion: 1)
- Do NOT invent custom keys (`additionalProperties: false` is enforced on root and version objects).
- Always include:
  - `"$schema": "https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json"`
  - `"schemaVersion": 1`
  - `"slug"` (`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]{0,63}$`)
  - `"name"` (display name)
  - `"latest"` (must match an exact key in `versions`)
  - `"versions"` (object map of version keys to release objects)
- Each version object under `versions.<ver>` requires:
  - `"url"`: direct `https://` download URL on a trusted host (`dl.vib.tools`, `github.com`, `objects.githubusercontent.com`, `release-assets.githubusercontent.com`, or configured `ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_HOSTS`).
- Optional version fields:
  - `"installer"`: per-version installer override (repo-relative path like `.vibtools/apps/installers/v1.0.2.ps1`, trusted `https://` script URL, or `{ "type": "powershell", "script": "..." }`). When omitted, inherits the root `installer`.
  - `"size"`: e.g. `"42.8 MB"`
  - `"sha256"`: 64-char hex checksum
  - `"released_at"`: strict `"YYYY-MM-DD"` (do NOT use `releaseDate`)
  - `"channel"`: `"stable" | "beta" | "alpha"`
  - `"deprecated"`: `true | false`

## Minimal Valid Example (.vibtools/apps/app.config.json)
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://apps.vib.tools/schemas/vibtools-app.schema.json",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "slug": "calgrid",
  "name": "CalGrid",
  "tagline": "Minimalist desktop calendar widget and event scheduler",
  "category": "Productivity",
  "access": "Free",
  "icon": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/icon.png",
  "latest": "v1.0.3",
  "installer": {
    "type": "powershell",
    "script": ".vibtools/apps/installer.ps1"
  },
  "docs": {
    "features": ".vibtools/apps/features.md",
    "changelog": ".vibtools/apps/changelog.md"
  },
  "platforms": ["Windows 10/11"],
  "architectures": ["x64"],
  "versions": {
    "v1.0.3": {
      "url": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.3/CalGrid-Setup-1.0.3.exe",
      "size": "42.8 MB",
      "sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
      "released_at": "2026-11-15"
    },
    "v1.0.2": {
      "url": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.2/CalGrid-Setup-1.0.2.exe",
      "installer": "https://dl.vib.tools/calgrid/v1.0.2/install.ps1",
      "size": "41.5 MB",
      "sha256": "9f83c605d4c82c3dd9e3b909c29fca53ca74c70284c717ec010746ff79c57c4c",
      "released_at": "2026-10-28"
    }
  }
}
```

## Edge Installer Contract (get.vib.tools)
When a user runs:
- `irm "https://get.vib.tools/<slug>" | iex` (installs `latest`)
- `irm "https://get.vib.tools/<slug>/<version>" | iex` (installs specific version)

`get.vib.tools` resolves the target version, picks `versions[version].installer` (or falls back to root `installer`), and prepends three sanitized PowerShell variables before streaming the script:
```powershell
$APP_SLUG = "calgrid"
$APP_VERSION = "v1.0.3"
$APP_NAME = "CalGrid"
```

Direct binary downloads route through:
- `https://get.vib.tools/dl/<slug>` -> 302 redirect to `versions[latest].url`
- `https://get.vib.tools/dl/<slug>/<version>` -> 302 redirect to `versions[version].url`

## Registering a Repository in vib-apps-hub
Add the GitHub repository URL directly to `registry.json`:
```json
[
  "https://github.com/vib-tools/calgrid"
]
```
The hub automatically extracts `owner/repo`, fetches `.vibtools/apps/app.config.json`, discovers `slug`, loads Markdown docs, and routes every version and installer.
